boards.school_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.description: Ten Rolla food stops with published evening or overnight availability, suitable for under-21 visitors.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Bishop
cards.subtitle: 1109 N Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Use the dining room before midnight or the drive-thru later; confirm holiday changes before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Rolla Taco Bell with overnight drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru service until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 AM–4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 9 AM–5 AM Friday–Saturday. Dine-in is listed until midnight; hours can vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Highway 72
cards.subtitle: 120 Highway 72 West, Rolla
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service after the dining room closes, and check the official locator for holiday-hour updates.
cards.short_summary: A second Rolla Taco Bell with 3 AM drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours from 9 AM to 3 AM daily and dine-in hours until 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 9 AM–3 AM daily; dine-in is listed until 11 PM. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Kings Highway
cards.subtitle: 1007 Kings Highway, Rolla
cards.notes: Choose counter service or drive-thru before 2 AM; verify holiday hours on the location page before making a late trip.
cards.short_summary: A Kings Highway restaurant listed open daily until 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Rolla location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6 AM to 2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed 6 AM–2 AM daily. The page notes that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut Classic on Kings Hwy
cards.subtitle: 1024 Kings Hwy, Rolla
cards.notes: Use dine-in, carryout, or delivery options, with Friday and Saturday listed latest; check the ordering mode before departure.
cards.short_summary: A retro-format Pizza Hut with midnight weekend restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Rolla page lists restaurant hours until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours: 10:30 AM–11 PM Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 AM–midnight Friday–Saturday. Delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Imo’s Pizza on S Bishop
cards.subtitle: 632 S Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Order for pickup, delivery, or the dining room before the published 10 PM closing time; verify special-day hours first.
cards.short_summary: A S Bishop pizza stop with service listed to 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Imo’s official Rolla store page lists hours until 10 PM Monday–Saturday and until 10 PM on Sunday after an 11 AM opening.
cards.access_notes: Listed open to 10 PM daily; Sunday begins at 11 AM. The page also lists delivery through the posted store hours.

cards.title: IHOP on N Bishop
cards.subtitle: 1735 N Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: For a later seated meal, target Friday or Saturday before midnight; takeout and online ordering are also listed.
cards.short_summary: A N Bishop diner with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Rolla page lists restaurant hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday and until 10 PM Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 6 AM–midnight Friday and Saturday; 6 AM–10 PM Sunday–Thursday. Dine-in and takeout are listed.

cards.title: Freddy’s on N Bishop
cards.subtitle: 2004 N Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Schedule this for Friday or Saturday when the published closing time is 11 PM; the location offers a drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A N Bishop steakburger and custard stop open to 11 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Freddy’s official Rolla announcement states hours of 10:30 AM–10 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–11 PM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 10:30 AM–10 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–11 PM Friday–Saturday; drive-thru service is stated.

cards.title: Sonic on S Bishop
cards.subtitle: 109 S Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Use the listed drive-in stop through 11 PM most nights or midnight Friday and Saturday; recheck before a late visit.
cards.short_summary: A S Bishop drive-in with midnight weekend availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonic’s official Rolla location listing gives hours until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sonic Drive-In — 109 S Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 6 AM–11 PM Sunday–Thursday and 6 AM–midnight Friday–Saturday. Check for location-specific changes.

cards.title: Denny’s on Martin Springs
cards.subtitle: 1419 Martin Springs Rd., Rolla
cards.notes: Aim to arrive before the posted 10 PM close; the official location page lists walk-ins, takeout, and family-friendly service.
cards.short_summary: A Martin Springs diner listed open nightly until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official Rolla location page lists restaurant hours of 6 AM to 10 PM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed as 6 AM–10 PM daily; contact the location to confirm hours, as its page advises.

cards.title: Los Arcos
cards.subtitle: Rolla, Missouri
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday evening window, when the restaurant lists a 10 PM close; confirm the day’s hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Rolla Mexican restaurant with 10 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Arcos’ official Rolla website lists hours until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday, with earlier closes on other days.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 11 AM–10 PM Friday and Saturday; Thursday ends at 9:30 PM, and other days close earlier.

boards.school_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct S&T study environments, from reservable collaboration rooms to staffed academic-support spaces.

cards.title: Library Room 327
cards.subtitle: Curtis Laws Wilson Library • third-floor meeting room
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person room for a focused working session; use its whiteboard wall and shared screen for planning or review.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor room built around a whiteboard wall and shared display.
cards.evidence_claim: Library Room 327 has a table, four chairs, a whiteboard wall, a large monitor, and ClickShare; its key is collected at the circulation desk after reservation.
cards.access_notes: Reserve the room first; the reservation holder or group member checks out and returns the key at the circulation desk.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 104
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Use this named shared room when your group needs a bookable campus setting; arrange the plan before opening the Outlook calendar.
cards.short_summary: One of the Innovation Lab’s student-reservable shared meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 104 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 105
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Book this distinct shared room for a small project meeting, then reset furniture and leave time for the next reservation.
cards.short_summary: A separate student-reservable Innovation Lab room for planned group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 105 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 110
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Choose this named room for a scheduled collaboration block, especially when your group needs a defined start and finish.
cards.short_summary: A bookable shared meeting room within the Innovation Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 110 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 111
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Reserve Room 111 for an intentional team work block and use the room’s flexible setup to match the task at hand.
cards.short_summary: A distinct, student-reservable shared room in the Innovation Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 111 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Lobby Lounge
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • open lounge
cards.notes: Set up in the lobby lounge for informal individual or group work; move to a reservable room if your task needs privacy.
cards.short_summary: An open-lounge option inside S&T’s collaboration-oriented Innovation Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Lab building program includes a lobby lounge, open study areas, and collaboration spaces of several sizes.
cards.access_notes: Open-lounge availability is not guaranteed; check building access conditions on arrival.

cards.title: Kummer Atrium
cards.subtitle: Butler-Carlton Hall • 1401 N. Pine St.
cards.notes: Bring a solo task or meet a classmate at the atrium tables; shift plans if a scheduled event is using the gathering space.
cards.short_summary: An atrium with study tables and modern seating in Butler-Carlton Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes the Kummer Atrium as a gathering place with study tables and modern seating for students to meet and study.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering
cards.access_notes: The atrium is also used for events, so check the space on arrival.

cards.title: Havener Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Havener Center • 1346 N. Bishop Ave.
cards.notes: Use one of Havener’s named study lounges between commitments; choose a different campus space when your work requires quiet isolation.
cards.short_summary: Named study-lounge spaces in S&T’s student-life center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Havener Center officially identifies Study Lounges as one of its study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Confirm building access and any event-related restrictions before settling in.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab Room 117 • 650 Tim Bradley Way
cards.notes: Work through course questions during drop-in tutoring or ask a success coach about study strategies, planning, and academic goals.
cards.short_summary: A staffed Innovation Lab hub for tutoring, study support, and success coaching.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center in Innovation Lab Room 117 offers free peer tutoring, group study options, and success coaching.
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours: Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Fri 10 a.m.–4 p.m. Drop-in tutoring availability varies by course and schedule.

cards.title: Writing & Communication Center
cards.subtitle: Curtis Laws Wilson Library 314–315
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, slide deck, or speaking plan for feedback; use a walk-in during standard hours or schedule an evening appointment.
cards.short_summary: A library-based consultation space for writing, speaking, and presentation projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing and Communication Center offers consultations for writing, speaking, and presenting ideas, with in-person tutoring in Curtis Laws Wilson Library Room 201 and its listed office at Room 314.
cards.access_notes: Walk-ins are welcome 9 a.m.–5 p.m. on open days; evening hours require an appointment. Verify the current room when booking.

warnings: The Writing and Communication Center’s current homepage lists in-person tutoring in Library Room 201 while its contact block lists Room 314; use its appointment system or contact the center to confirm the meeting location.

boards.school_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented components of Missouri S&T’s student-led Best Ever St. Pat’s celebration in Rolla.

cards.title: The “Best Ever” St. Pat’s
cards.subtitle: Missouri S&T’s annual St. Patrick’s tradition
cards.notes: Use the official St. Pat’s page to follow the current season’s events and learn how this 1908 celebration grew around campus and Rolla.
cards.short_summary: Missouri S&T’s defining St. Patrick’s celebration dates to 1908.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T identifies St. Pat’s as its most enduring and defining tradition; the celebration began in 1908.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: A multi-event celebration; consult the official event listings for current participation details.

cards.title: Drive the snakes out of Rolla
cards.subtitle: Opening St. Pat’s ritual outside Toomey and Parker halls
cards.notes: See the fenced snake pits during St. Pat’s opening events, where participants answer tradition questions and use plastic snakes in the ritual.
cards.short_summary: A campus opening ritual centered on symbolic plastic snakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes Snake Invasion as the first St. Pat’s event, held outside Toomey and Parker halls.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Follow current St. Pat’s event guidance and staff instructions at the snake pits.

cards.title: Paint Pine Street green
cards.subtitle: St. Pat’s parade-day tradition in downtown Rolla
cards.notes: Look for the green-painted Pine Street on parade day; the official history says St. Pat’s Board alumni handle the early-morning painting.
cards.short_summary: Alumni paint the parade route green before the Rolla procession.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T states that St. Pat’s Board alumni paint Pine Street green from end to end before the annual parade.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Observe from public areas and respect parade-day street closures and event staff directions.

cards.title: Follow the green parade downtown
cards.subtitle: Annual procession on Pine Street, Rolla
cards.notes: Check the official schedule for the parade date, then watch the Court of St. Patrick, campus groups and local businesses move along Pine Street.
cards.short_summary: The celebration’s downtown procession features the Court and community groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T says the annual parade is held on Pine Street and is led by the Court of St. Patrick.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Use the current official schedule and local traffic guidance for viewing locations.

cards.title: Meet the Court at Coronation
cards.subtitle: Court of St. Patrick ceremony, typically at Leach Theatre
cards.notes: Consult the current St. Pat’s schedule for this court ceremony, which recognizes honorary knights and knights student queens and knights.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony recognizing the Court and honorary knights.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes Coronation as honoring the Court of St. Patrick and the year’s eight honorary knights.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Typically held at Leach Theatre; verify the venue and attendance details in the current schedule.

cards.title: Welcome St. Pat’s court
cards.subtitle: Ceremonial arrival during the Best Ever St. Pat’s
cards.notes: Watch the official event listings for the court’s arrival and procession, a named ceremony within the annual St. Pat’s celebration.
cards.short_summary: The St. Pat’s Court has its own ceremonial arrival and procession.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T lists Court Arrival and Grand Procession among the named St. Pat’s events.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Confirm timing and location through the official St. Pat’s event schedule.

cards.title: Make room for Follies
cards.subtitle: Named performance tradition within St. Pat’s
cards.notes: Find the current Follies listing during St. Pat’s week; it remains one of the named events Missouri S&T includes in the celebration.
cards.short_summary: Follies is a recurring named performance component of St. Pat’s.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T lists Follies as a named event in its official St. Pat’s celebration program.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Verify the current program, venue and participation details with St. Pat’s organizers.

cards.title: Catch Grateful Board
cards.subtitle: Named St. Pat’s event in downtown Rolla
cards.notes: Look for the current Grateful Board announcement during St. Pat’s season; Missouri S&T lists it among the celebration’s distinct events.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown event presented as part of the St. Pat’s program.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T lists Grateful Board among the official events that make up its St. Pat’s celebration.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Check the current official event listing for date, venue and entry details.

cards.title: Join Gonzo & Games
cards.subtitle: Named activity tradition within St. Pat’s
cards.notes: Use the official St. Pat’s schedule to locate Gonzo & Games and follow organizer instructions for the current edition’s activities.
cards.short_summary: Gonzo & Games is a named participatory element of the annual program.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T lists Gonzo & Games among the official events in its St. Pat’s celebration.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Consult the official schedule for the current location, format and participation requirements.

cards.title: Spot the Board’s green jackets
cards.subtitle: Signature apparel of Missouri S&T’s student-led St. Pat’s Board
cards.notes: Notice the green letterman jackets with shamrocks worn by St. Pat’s Board members during the celebration; ask organizers about board involvement.
cards.short_summary: Shamrock letterman jackets identify the student leaders behind St. Pat’s.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T says St. Pat’s Board members are recognizable by green letterman jackets featuring a shamrock.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: The jackets identify board members; participation in the board is governed by its current recruitment process.

boards.school_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.title: Your First Weekend at Missouri University of Science and Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence centered on named campus destinations and activities in Rolla.

cards.title: Start at Havener Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • 1346 North Bishop Avenue
cards.notes: Begin by orienting yourself in the student center: find the lounges, game room, student involvement area and dining options before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus student center as a practical first landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T identifies Havener Center as the heart of student life and lists study lounges, a game room, Student Involvement, the bookstore and dining there.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily operating hours; confirm holiday or break hours before visiting.

cards.title: Pick up a simple campus breakfast
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Havener Center
cards.notes: Choose a bagel or breakfast sandwich at the Havener Center counter, then use the building as your starting point for the day’s walk.
cards.short_summary: A named weekend breakfast option inside Havener Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T Dining lists Einstein Bros. Bagels in Havener Center and publishes weekend hours of 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
cards.source_title: Havener Center | Dining Services | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: The dining page lists weekend hours as 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify service status during breaks.

cards.title: Settle in at Curtis Laws Wilson Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • 400 W. 14th Street
cards.notes: Walk through the library to locate a study floor and circulation desk, then save the building as a dependable campus reference point.
cards.short_summary: A campus library stop with published extended hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T’s January 2026 announcement lists Curtis Laws Wilson Library hours, including 7 a.m. to midnight Monday through Thursday and noon to midnight Sunday.
cards.source_title: Library announces new hours | Missouri S&T eConnection
cards.access_notes: Campus ID is required after 8 p.m. on the days identified in the official hours announcement.

cards.title: See the Innovation Lab atrium
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • 650 Tim Bradley Way
cards.notes: Continue through the Arrival District and look through the shared spaces, atrium and student-resource areas to understand the building’s layout.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused innovation building connected to Havener Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T says the Innovation Lab is connected to Havener Center and includes collaboration spaces, a lobby lounge, the Maker Studio and Student Success Center.
cards.source_title: About the Innovation Lab | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: The Innovation Lab publishes daily building hours; room access and reservations can vary.

cards.title: Plan a future Maker Studio session
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Innovation Lab Room 205
cards.notes: Take note of the Maker Studio location and required safety training, then plan a later session once you have completed the access steps.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on studio for materials ranging from wood to electronics.
cards.evidence_claim: The Makers Studio lists tools for wood, fabric, 3D printing, electronics, vinyl and jewelry, and requires online and in-person safety training for access.
cards.access_notes: Located in Innovation Lab Room 205; complete required safety training before using studio equipment.

cards.title: Take an outdoor reset at The Puck
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Missouri S&T campus
cards.notes: Use this outdoor campus landmark for a daylight pause between indoor stops; check the event calendar if you want to avoid a scheduled gathering.
cards.short_summary: An identifiable outdoor campus space for informal gatherings and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes The Puck as an outdoor campus space used for gatherings, concerts, performances and outdoor study sessions.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Spaces | Events and Hospitality Management | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Outdoor availability may change for reserved events or weather; use the venue calendar or posted signage.

cards.title: Find the campus Stonehenge replica
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Northwest edge of campus
cards.notes: Make this a daylight photo-and-walk stop, staying on designated campus paths and giving any scheduled event setup space if it is in use.
cards.short_summary: A half-scale Stonehenge reconstruction on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T’s outdoor-spaces page identifies Missouri S&T Stonehenge as a half-scale reconstruction of the ancient monument on the northwest edge of campus.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Spaces | Events and Hospitality Management | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Visit outdoors in daylight and respect any event reservations or temporary access controls.

cards.title: Locate the recreation and fitness center
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon • Gale Bullman Multi-Purpose Building
cards.notes: Stop by the Gale Bullman building to identify the recreation and fitness center entrance, then check its official hours and eligibility before returning.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation destination housed in Gale Bullman.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T lists the Student Recreation and Fitness Center at the Gale Bullman Multi-Purpose Building, 705 W. 10th Street.
cards.source_title: Contact Us | Student Recreation and Fitness Center | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Consult the recreation center’s current hours and participation requirements before working out.

cards.title: Check the Leach Theatre calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Castleman Hall
cards.notes: Browse the current performance calendar and select an all-ages event that fits your schedule; buy or collect tickets through the theatre’s stated process.
cards.short_summary: A 550-seat campus theatre with concerts, dance, talks and productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T states that Leach Theatre in Castleman Hall presents performances for audiences of all ages, including productions, concerts, dance and student showcases.
cards.access_notes: Programming and tickets vary by event; the box office opens one hour before each event according to the theatre ticket page.

cards.title: Close with the self-guided campus tour
cards.subtitle: Sunday daylight • campus map route
cards.notes: Use the official interactive map’s self-guided-tour option to revisit landmarks you noticed and pin buildings you will need during your first week.
cards.short_summary: An official map-based way to connect the weekend’s campus stops.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T’s Campus Map page includes a Self-Guided Tour option alongside its campus-building directory and map tools.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Map | Campus Directory | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Use the live campus map for current building and parking information; follow any posted access restrictions.
